name: Saurian
description: Saurians are more heavily built than the average human, warm-blooded and omnivorous. They have advanced to full sentience, albeit not very highly intelligent compared to humans, and are capable of abstract thought and clever innovation. Although they have a hunter culture, Saurians are peaceable and friendly towards others. They are quite accepting of strangers even if they belong to a species the Saurians have never seen. Saurians are capable of great violence and some serve as guards or soldiers in human settlements. They are not reluctant to fight but have a strong sense of what is necessary and what is not. Their thick, scaly skin provides natural protection against blows and minor injuries.

starting_equipment.name: Natural Armour
starting_equipment.notes: Thick, scaly skin; Protection +2. Stacks with worn armour. Cannot be removed.

traits.name: Armour (+2)
traits.description: Saurians have thick, scaly skin that can shrug off light blows without a scratch. They have natural armour Protection +2.

species_notes: STR and END receive +2 modifiers applied to standard 2D6 rolls.
INT rolled as 2D3 (range 2–6); EDU rolled as 1D (range 1–6) — applied automatically by the engine.
Natural Armour: Protection +2 — shown in equipment list. Stacks with worn armour.
Career preferences (source material): Citizen (worker), Drifter (barbarian, wanderer).
source: Aliens of Charted Space, Mongoose Publishing
